newsitem.title: USA: Williams Cos unit expands sales offices.
newsitem.headline: Williams Cos unit expands sales offices.

text.p: Vyvx Inc, a subsidiary of Williams Co Inc, said Friday it is expanding its East coast and West coast sales offices and opening a Western region sports office in Salt Lake City.

Vyvx, which provides integrated fiber-optic, satellite amd teleport video transmission services, said the addition of nine representatives will help its sales force offer more complete service to customers.
Williams Cos is a communications services provider.
Its shares were up 1-1/8 Friday at 43-3/4.
